reason: The primary abstract describes Extracting accurate labels from radiology reports is essential for training medical image analysis models. Large language models (LLMs) show promise for automating this proces…. The identified task is Role of Model Size and Prompting Strategies in Extracting Labels from Free-Text Radiology Reports with Open-Source Large Language Models; it does not establish an LLM inference-system efficiency contribution.
title: Role of Model Size and Prompting Strategies in Extracting Labels from Free-Text Radiology Reports with Open-Source Large Language Models
